[[Sepahan F.C.|Sepahan]] were the [[2010–11 Persian Gulf Cup|defending champions]]. The season featured 15 teams from the [[2010–11 Persian Gulf Cup]] and three new teams promoted from the [[2010–11 Azadegan League]]: [[S.C. Damash Gilan|Damash]] as champions, [[Mes Sarcheshmeh F.C.|Mes Sarcheshmeh]] and [[Fajr Sepasi Shiraz F.C.|Fajr Sepasi]]. The league started on 2 August 2011 and ended on 11 May 2012. [[Sepahan F.C.|Sepahan]] won the Pro League title for the fourth time in their history (total fourth Iranian title).
